narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Three dates in a line go up by one, so they are seventeen, eighteen and nineteen.
<bookmark mark='test'/>Those sit side by side in a row, and they add to fifty four.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>That is not fifty one, and they are not one below the other.
